references.text: Describes Israel's crossing of the Jordan River under Joshua's leadership, as referenced in the verse.
Tells of the conquest of Jericho, where the Lord gave the city into the hands of the Israelites.
Describes Israel's victory over the Amorites, one of the peoples mentioned in the verse.
Lists the seven nations that lived in Canaan, including those mentioned in this verse.
God's promise to bring Israel to a land where Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites lived.
God's promise to drive out the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
Mentions the victory over the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan, a parallel to the victory over the peoples in this verse.
Confirms that God gave the inhabitants of Canaan and their kings into the hands of the Israelites.
Describes how God drove out the nations and planted Israel in the land.
Praises God for striking down great kings and giving their land as an inheritance to Israel.
